notes.title: v1.30 - Two bug fixes and one extra option
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Skills that "always hit" like Eternity Rising, Bulls-eye, and Ajna can now hit Ranged-Only enemies.
[*]Fixed rare bug that caused the beginning of a scene near the end of the game to start with a black screen for several seconds.
[*]Added option to the System menu to increase damage taken: 1x - 10x
[/list]

notes.title: v1.25 - Bug Fix
notes.content:
v1.25 has been released with a bug fix:
1. The Flash Bomb puzzles in Tenebrous Reef could get stuck in a state where they couldn't be solved.

notes.title: v1.20 - Change Log
notes.content:
v1.20 has been released with the following changes:
[olist]
[*]Fixed crash when Asera equips the Throg Shard or any other one with TP skills.
[*]Throg no longer shows an empty MP bar when equipping a Shard with MP moves. Asera no longer shows an empty TP bar when equipping a Shard with TP moves.
[*]Throg's status effect skills (Venom, Melatonin, Madness, Possess, Delusion) now hit an area and chances of status are increased from 75% to 80%
[*]All of the Wraiths' physical attacks were being absorbed by the Bell accessories
[*]Fixed Earth Wraith's 50% threshold buff which was using too much stamina
[*]Xero's Replenish skill cooldown changed from 3 to 1
[*]Bacillus now has the "Flying" break type so it can be hit by Turbulence and Wing Breaker
[*]Can now call the airship from the top of Mt Saratai so you don't have to walk back down
[*]Added icon for the "Charge Backfire" status in the Flash Golem battles
[*]Fixed stairs in Burns' sidequest that warped to the wrong tile
[*]Fixed two Roamers at Damri Mountain that couldn't be radiated
[*]Stadium Sewer Angst starts with a bit less stamina and can be blinded
[/olist]

v1.20.1 has been released to fix the following bug:
[list]
[*]Fixed problem with the F12 disable script causing a crash. Some computers may now no longer disable F12. If you are one of these rare cases, do not hit F12 while playing or it will cause all sorts of weirdness.
[/list]

v1.20.2 has been released to fix the following bug:
[olist]
[*]Fixed Flash Bombs when using WASD
[*]Followers weren't turned back on after Water Wraith fight
[*]Enda's Antitoxin and Clarify skills now use only 800 stamina
[*]Cross Sash agility boost lowered from 15% to 10%
[/olist]
